questions.stem: Which of the following doesn't inhibit Cytochrome?
questions.solutionHtml:
Explanation:

Electron transport chain Complex IV contains cytochrome a and cytochrome a3

Inhibitors:

  • Carbon monoxide
  • Cyanide
  • Azide
  • Hydrogen sulfide


Vasudevan’s Textbook of Biochemistry for Medical Students, 7th edition, Page 226

questions.stem: A 5-year-old girl was washing her doll with shampoo containing rotenone. Her mother noticed her in unconscious state. Which is inhibited by the above chemical?
questions.solutionHtml:
Correct Option A - NADH dehydrogenase

  • Rotenone inhibits NADH dehydrogenase.

 

Incorrect Options:

  • Options B, C, and D are not inhibited by rotenone.
